verdict.rationale: The only webhook evidence is a product-page claim that users can receive alerts via webhooks when tasks fail. That is outbound event delivery, but it covers only one event type and has no supporting docs. The Realtime API streams run updates, but it is a live-subscription mechanism, not a webhook. Missing for 10: webhook subscriptions for events beyond task failures (run started/completed, deploys), documentation of payload format, signing/verification, retry/delivery guarantees and subscription management via API, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
